title: India in December: Where to Go for Sun, Snow and Festive Weeks
seo_title: India in December: Where to Go, Weather & Snow
seo_desc: Where to go in India in December: sun in Goa, Kerala and Rajasthan, snow in the Himachal hills, official temperatures, fog and Christmas–New Year tips.
label: India in December
blurb: Sun in Goa, Kerala and Rajasthan or snow in Himachal — weather, crowds and plans
tag: December: sun in the south, snow in the hills.
sub: December is one of the best months to travel in India — almost the whole country is in season at once. Here is where the weather works, what the official temperatures say in °C and °F, where you may see snow, and what to plan around over Christmas and New Year. Written by a travel company based in the Himalaya.
hero_alt: Snow on the rooftops of Shimla's hillside houses, the Taj Mahal reflected in its long pool, houseboats on the Kerala backwaters at dusk and Palolem beach in South Goa from the air
q: Is December a good time to visit India?
answer: Yes. December is one of the best months to visit India: the Golden Triangle (Delhi, Agra, Jaipur) and Rajasthan are dry with sunny days, Kerala and Goa are in peak season, and the Himachal hill towns such as Shimla often get snow. Nights in the north are cold and fog can slow mornings, and Christmas–New Year is busy — book early. Send us your dates for a quote.

sections.h2: Snow in December: the Himachal hills
sections.lead: We are based in Himachal, so this is the question we hear most. Snow in December is likely in the hills but never certain. The India Meteorological Department's long-term figures for Shimla:
sections.note: Shimla's district administration says nights in December–January fall to about 0 °C (32 °F) and asks visitors to book hotels early for Christmas and New Year. Snowfall is also common in winter in Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj. Above Manali, Rohtang Pass closes from late November until about May, but the Atal Tunnel keeps the road to Lahaul open. More detail: Shimla in December and Manali in December.

sections.h2: Sun in December: the south and the desert
sections.lead: If you want warm days rather than snow, December is the start of the best stretch for these:
items: Kerala Tourism names November–February as peak season and October–February as the best time for houseboat cruises; December–February is mild. Up in Thekkady it can drop to 13 °C (55 °F), so pack a layer. See our houseboat guide.
Goa's foreign visitors come in winter, and Incredible India gives Palolem's best months as November to February. Christmas and New Year are very busy — book early.
Clear days and cold desert nights: Jodhpur averages 6–32 °C (43–89 °F) in December, and Incredible India gives Jaisalmer's best time as November to March. A night at a desert camp needs warm clothes.

Delhi, Agra and Jaipur are dry and comfortable by day. Morning fog can delay early starts and sunrise at the Taj, so we keep spare time in the plan. The Taj Mahal opens 30 minutes before sunrise and is closed on Fridays.

sections.h2: What to plan around in December
items: The Christmas–New Year weeks are very busy in Goa, Kerala, Rajasthan and the hill towns. If those are your dates, book flights, hotels and your car early.
The UK FCDO advises: 'Avoid travelling at night and in fog as accidents are common due to low visibility.' In December we plan daytime drives only and keep buffer time on long road days.
North India is cold before sunrise and after dark, and the hills are colder still. Our India packing list covers layers for a winter trip.

Gulmarg's ski season usually starts around mid-December. The UK FCDO advises against all travel to Jammu and Kashmir except Jammu city, and the US State Department says 'Do not travel' to J&K except eastern Ladakh and Leh (advice checked 23 Oct 2026). Check the latest before you book — see our Gulmarg guide.
Apply yourself only at the official site indianvisaonline.gov.in — beware look-alike sites that charge extra. We are not a visa agency. Our e-Visa guide walks through it.
Cold and altitude in the hills affect some people. Consult your doctor before you travel, and see CDC or NHS Fit for Travel.
With a private car, your driver's name, photo and car number are shared with you before the trip, and our Himachal office is a phone call away. See our private car with driver.

faqs: Is December a good time to visit India?

Yes, for most of the country. The Golden Triangle, Rajasthan, Kerala and Goa are all in season, and the Himachal hills often get snow. Plan for cold nights and morning fog in the north, and book early if you travel over Christmas and New Year.
Where is it warm in India in December?

Kerala and Goa are warm and in peak season, and Rajasthan has warm, sunny days — Jodhpur averages up to 32 °C (89 °F) — with cold nights. Delhi, Agra and Jaipur are pleasant by day and cold in the early morning.
Does it snow in India in December?

Yes, in the Himalaya. The India Meteorological Department's average December snowfall in Shimla is about 7 cm, and snowfall is common in winter in Manali, Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj. Snow is never guaranteed on a given date.
How cold is North India in December?
Shimla averages 4.8–13.1 °C (41–56 °F) in December, with nights near freezing. On the plains days are mild but early mornings are cold and foggy. Bring warm layers, a jacket and a hat.
Is India crowded at Christmas and New Year?
Yes — the Christmas–New Year weeks are very busy in Goa, Kerala, Rajasthan and the hill towns. Book flights, hotels and your car early; Shimla's district administration gives the same advice.
Is Goa or Kerala better in December?

Both are in season. Kerala suits backwaters, tea hills and culture; Goa suits beaches and a slower pace. Either pairs well with the Golden Triangle — tell us what you enjoy and we suggest the better fit.
Can I see tigers in December?

Yes, the parks are open. Corbett's Dhikala zone opens from 15 November and central India's reserves are best from October to June. Sightings are never guaranteed, and safari permits are booked through the official portals.
